name: keycloak_high_registration_failure_rate
title: Keycloak high registration failure rate
description: More than 10% of registration attempts are failing in realm.

source.upstream_query: (sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_registrations_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_registrations_total[5m]))) * 100 > 10 and sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_registrations_total[5m])) > 0
source.upstream_description: More than 10% of registration attempts are failing in realm {{ $labels.realm }} (current value: {{ $value | printf "%.1f" }}%).
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: ((sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_registrations_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_registrations_total[5m]))) * 100 > 10 and sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_registrations_total[5m])) > 0) * 0 + 1

notes: Threshold of 10% is a rough default.
